name: GL_AUTOMATIC_POSTING_SETS
description: GL_AUTOMATIC_POSTING_SETS contains the automatic posting sets you defined in the AutoPost Criteria Set program. Each row includes the name and description of your set and its set level criteria. There is a one-to-many relationship between a row in this table and rows in the GL_AUTOMATIC_POSTING_OPTIONS table.

columns.name: AUTOPOST_SET_ID
columns.description: Journal autopost set unique identifier.

columns.name: AUTOPOST_SET_NAME
columns.description: User entered journal autopost set name.

columns.name: SUBMIT_ALL_PRIORITIES_FLAG
columns.description: Submit all priorities defined in the set for posting flag.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Whether or not autopost set is enabled.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Journal autopost set description.

columns.name: NUM_OF_PRIORITY_OPTIONS
columns.description: Number of top priorities in the set to be submitted for posting.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DAYS_BEFORE
columns.description: Number of days prior to the submission date.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DAYS_AFTER
columns.description: Days the system counts after a submission date when determining the journal entries to select for automatic posting.
